lines.text: Many learners say: She is nice, isn't it?
Better: She is nice, isn't she?
Isn't he. He is tired, isn't he?

native.tip: Türkçede hep “değil mi?” deriz; İngilizcede sondaki soru cümlenin öznesine uyar: “She is nice, isn't she?”
native.caption: “She is nice, isn't it?” mi diyorsun? 😅 Sondaki soru özneye uyar: “she” ile “isn't she” gelir. Doğrusu “She is nice, isn't she?” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “isn't he”. “Değil mi?” yerine özneye uyan soruyu kur. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: The short question at the end matches the subject: “She is nice, isn't she?”
en.caption: Do you say “She is nice, isn't it?” 😅 In English the short question at the end matches the subject: she goes with isn't she. The right sentence is “She is nice, isn't she?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
